newsitem.title: USA: Merrill Lynch Q2 profit a record.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch Q2 profit a record.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Co Inc's second quarter net earnings of $481 million were the highest of any quarter in the firm's history, eclipsing a mark set just a quarter ago.

In topping its first quarter profit of $465 million, Merrill bucked an industry trend. A weak stock market performance early in the quarter kept many firms from improving over the industry's very strong first quarter.
Merrill Lynch experienced revenue growth at nearly all its major business lines in the quarter and also saw compensation costs trimmed as a fraction of net revenues versus last year.

Compensation and benefits expenses shrunk to 50.5 percent of net revenues versus 51.5 percent last year, Merrill Lynch said. Actual costs rose 15 percent to $2.0 billion in the quarter, the company said, due to higher incentive compensation and headcount increases.
Net revenues totalled $3.97 billion, up 3.3 percent from the first quarter and 17.3 percent from a year ago.
Merrill posted higher revenues in its investment banking, principal transactions and asset management business versus the first quarter but commissions revenues fell 3.3 percent.
Merrill's first half earnings of $947 million were also a record for the firm and a 12.3 percent improvement over $843 million last year.
Its average return on equity was 28.5 percent, up slightly from 28.3 percent in the first quarter but down from 29.2 percent a year ago.
Total assets in the firm's worldwide accounts reached a record $940 billion at the end of the second quarter, up $72 billion from the end of the first quarter.
Assets under management at Merrill Lynch Asset Management also set a record at $257 billion, up $10 billion in the quarter.
The company's effective tax rate edged down to 37.0 percent to 37.9 percent.
